work.author: GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei
work.description: Bull V transfers Crema from Bologna to the metropolitan see of Milan; protocol GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS / servus servorum Dei LF826–827; LF858 → LF864 across running title LF861; executor, decernentes, derogation, transumpt and Nulli ergo clauses lead to the full 5 February 1835 dating LF993–996. Its own provenance LF783 lies on the preceding page and is excluded as furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS servus servorum Dei at LF826–827; the source closing at LF993–996 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum anno incar- nationis dominicae millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto nonis februarii, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
